name: print-social-poster-collection-vol-1-cover-with-strip-of-posters
title: Poster collection cover with a bold title and a fanned strip of many poster styles
whatItIs: A white cover with a heavy black 'Poster Collection' flanked by rules, 'For 2025' below, and a horizontal strip of narrow poster crops (green circles, blossom photo, blur, dark serif, orange collage, blue type) with 'Vol. 1' at the base.
whatItMeans: Confident and curated; a strip previews range in one glance.
techniques: Show posters as narrow vertical crops.

vocabulary.definition: Narrow crops of many posters side by side.
A heading flanked by horizontal lines.
Variety across a body of work.
